source.source: Kite historical BANKNIFTY index minute candles

methodology.entry: Range is completed before two OCO stop levels become active; fill is the touched level or adverse gap-open price
methodology.ambiguity: If both OCO levels occur inside one source bar, no profit is credited and the setup must re-arm
methodology.stops: Existing stop is checked before trailing logic on every bar; an entry-bar stop is assumed hit when OHLC ordering is uncertain
methodology.trailing: New trails use completed bars and apply only afterward; a trail already crossed at close exits next bar open
methodology.reentry: After exit or rejected trigger, price must close back inside the original range before another trigger
methodology.eod: Open trades exit at 15:29 minute close
methodology.validation: 15-minute discovery followed by minute replay on train and development; final chronological validation evaluated afterward
methodology.limitation: BANKNIFTY index points; historical futures basis, slippage and contract rolls are not available
